description: Fault Activity Map of California (2010) is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Department of Conservation. "This digital database contains the faults shown on the Fault Activity Map of California by Charles W. Jennings and William A. Bryant published in 2010. The map shows locations of known faults that can be portrayed at 1:750,000 scale and indicates the latest age when displacements took place, according to available data. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California Department of Conservation. Its tags are CAOpenData, CGS, CNRA, California, California Department of Conservation. It offers 2 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
